name: StableCoinVault (SCLP) public _swap aggregator call
summary: The ApolloX-based StableCoinVault (SCLP shares, proxy 0xd1884922) left its internal _swap(tokenForSwap, aggregatorData) public: it approves the 1inch router for the vault's whole balance of any token and forwards caller-supplied calldata to it. Callers passed 1inch unoswapTo calls that routed the approved balance to themselves, taking the vault's APX rewards in two small drains and finally its 8,693 ALP position, which the last attacker redeemed with ApolloX for 10,611 USDT.
notes: Anchor: the earliest _swap call by a non-vault caller, 0xfa9028a6 (block 35096279, 322.57 APX to 0x6d550ccd); 0x54126076 took 1,001.21 APX and DeFiHackLabs' 0x9983ca8e the ALP. All three senders are unrelated to the deployer 0x78000b06.

Reset: setting the 1inch aggregator address (slot 0x166) in 0x5675a3fb, 122 blocks after the proxy's creation; _swap reverts while it is unset. No other implementation the deployer ran on BSC exposes the _swap selector.
Loss: ALP-APO-ALP has no price and is valued at the 10,610.92 USDT the attacker redeemed it for (rule 12); APX at DefiLlama prices.
